Package com.project.cooking.meals

Class Meal

java.lang.Object
com.project.cooking.meals.Meal
public class Meal extends Object
Represents a meal that consists of multiple ingredients and has a price. Supports both ingredient objects and simple ingredient names.
Author:
omar
